note: Knowledge-cutoff probes. UNLIKE the reasoning probes, these are CURATED, not generated: a fact's answer must come from a trusted source, not an algorithm, so there is no solver and no per-run regeneration. That makes the anti-hardcoding property weaker than the reasoning family (same structural weakness as hvoy). Mitigations: (1) each item carries its source + date so it is auditable and re-curatable; (2) sample a random subset per run from a pool kept larger than any single run.
purpose: Detect substitution by a model whose training cutoff predates these events. Does NOT distinguish two current-generation models (e.g. gpt-5.5 vs gpt-5.6-sol) — their cutoffs are too close. Low value under the subscription-reverse threat model, where an arbitrary old model cannot be sourced.

calibration.result: answered 4/5 correctly; darts item dropped as too niche for stable recall even on the genuine model

answer_window: Events must fall AFTER a plausible old-model cutoff and BEFORE the current model's cutoff. Jan 2026 events clear this for gpt-5.6-sol (confirmed above). Re-verify when the reference model changes.
instruction: Answer only from your own training knowledge. Do not browse, search, or call tools. Reply with just the name/country/number, nothing else. If you do not know, reply UNKNOWN.

items.q: Which automaker surpassed Tesla as the world's best-selling electric-vehicle maker based on 2025 sales?
Which country adopted the euro and became the 21st member of the eurozone on January 1, 2026?
Who became President of Switzerland on January 1, 2026?
Ciudad de la Paz became the new capital of which country in January 2026?
